lines.3: Those last two points feel like an enormous wall.
lines.11: 「You came very close on the test.」
lines.13: 「And while your English was excellent, your scores in the other subjects did not improve.」
lines.14: I'd like some credit for not letting them fall.
lines.15: ...But that would just be making excuses.
lines.18: 「Still... I will acknowledge that you worked hard.」
lines.19: 「That you went to such lengths for my sake.」
